```{python}
#| echo: false

import ast
import os
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, HTML

def read_engine_rate(script_path, var_name, fallback=0.0):
    """Safely extracts the hardcoded policy rate constant from an engine .py file."""
    if not os.path.exists(script_path):
        return fallback
    with open(script_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        tree = ast.parse(f.read(), filename=script_path)
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == var_name:
                    if isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value.value, (int, float)):
                        return float(node.value.value)
    return fallback

CENTRAL_BANKS = [
    {
        'name': 'Federal Reserve (Fed)',
        'script': 'fed_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_EFFR',
        'file': 'data/fomc_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_fed.html'
    },
    {
        'name': 'European Central Bank (ECB)',
        'script': 'ecb_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_DFR',
        'file': 'data/ecb_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_ecb.html'
    },
    {
        'name': 'Bank of England (BoE)',
        'script': 'boe_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_BANK_RATE',
        'file': 'data/boe_implied_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_boe.html'
    },
    {
        'name': 'Bank of Japan (BoJ)',
        'script': 'boj_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_BOJ_RATE',
        'file': 'data/boj_implied_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_boj.html'
    },
    {
        'name': 'Bank of Canada (BoC)',
        'script': 'boc_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_BOC_RATE',
        'file': 'data/boc_implied_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_boc.html'
    },
    {
        'name': 'Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA)',
        'script': 'rba_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_RBA_RATE',
        'file': 'data/rba_implied_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_rba.html'
    },
    {
        'name': 'Swiss National Bank (SNB)',
        'script': 'snb_rate_engine.py',
        'var': 'CURRENT_SNB_RATE',
        'file': 'data/snb_implied_curve.csv',
        'link': 'rates_snb.html'
    }
]

summary_rows = []

for meta in CENTRAL_BANKS:
    if os.path.exists(meta['file']):
        df = pd.read_csv(meta['file'])
        if not df.empty:
            next_mtg = df.iloc[0]
            next_date = next_mtg.get('meeting_date', 'N/A')
            next_implied = next_mtg.get('implied_post_rate', next_mtg.get('implied_rate', 0.0))
            cur_rate = read_engine_rate(meta['script'], meta['var'])
            change_bps = round((next_implied - cur_rate) * 100, 1)
            
            summary_rows.append({
                'Central Bank': f"<a href='{meta['link']}'><b>{meta['name']}</b></a>",
                'Current Policy Rate': f"{cur_rate:.2f}%",
                'Next Meeting Date': str(next_date),
                'Next Implied Rate': f"{next_implied:.2f}%",
                'Expected Move (bps)': f"{change_bps:+} bps"
            })

df_summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
```
